name.description: Saved name for an unnamed HTTP service; named services use their service key unless overridden.

server.description: Control URL used by this project.

team.description: Unique lowercase team name or team ID used by this project.

feedback.description: Show the feedback toolbar on development pages.

oauth.description: Publish one shared OAuth callback URL while project tunnels run.

inspection.description: Local inspection capture and retention for HTTP and supported TCP services.

domain.description: Ready team domain used for generated public URL hostnames.

hostname.description: Exact public URL hostname or HTTPS origin to publish. The saved name belongs on the service, not inside publicURL.

ephemeral.description: Remove the public URL when this tunnel stops.

public_url.description: Defaults applied only to explicit services.NAME.public_url blocks. These defaults never enable a public URL for another service.

aws.description: Generate an AWS Fargate group stack; supply infrastructure settings as deployment parameters.

publishers.description: Named publisher groups with a durable namespace beneath a ready team domain. local is reserved for the built-in local publisher.

public_url.description: Explicitly enable public HTTPS for this HTTP service. Omit this block for private HTTP. Root public URL defaults apply only when this block is present.

server_name.description: Target certificate hostname or IP; defaults to the resolved target host. Required when applying an app target before its listener is known.

ca_file.description: Project-relative CA-only PEM file added to system roots; omit for system roots only.

tls.description: Verified publisher-to-target TLS. The protocol selects PostgreSQL or MySQL native negotiation, or direct TLS for HTTP/TCP. Independent of mandatory managed visitor TLS; never falls back to plaintext or unverified TLS.

services.description: Named services. Only an explicit service public_url block enables public HTTPS; all other services are private, including HTTP.

service.description: Configured local HTTP service with an explicit public_url block. App, address, Compose and Docker targets are supported.

webhooks.description: Stable project webhook endpoints, delivered to running worktrees.

service.description: Configured entry service serving the alias.

name.description: Relative DNS name beneath the member namespace; defaults to the alias key. Nested names require server permission.

domain.description: Ready team domain; otherwise inherit the entry service's domain.

public_url.description: Exact authorized public URL hostname or HTTPS origin; mutually exclusive with name and domain.

aliases.description: Saved project public URLs assigned to the primary checkout by default, or explicitly to another worktree.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors and validation tools.

tnl.description: Project configuration used by the tnl client.

database_url.description: Pooled PostgreSQL URL used by control and standalone.

metrics_listen.description: Private Prometheus listen address; empty disables metrics.

control_listen.description: Private HTTP backend for the deployment's control HTTPS proxy.

control_trusted_proxies.description: Exact trusted control HTTPS proxy peer CIDRs.

control_client_ip_header.description: Source header overwritten by the trusted control HTTPS proxy.

private_control_listen.description: Private control API listen address for ingress and relays.

ingress_udp_listen.description: Private connector QUIC listen address for split ingress; defaults to the ingress TCP bind address.

dns_server.description: DNS resolver used to verify custom domains. Defaults to the system resolver.

server_domain.description: Infrastructure DNS suffix used to derive control, ingress, and relay hostnames.

control_url.description: External HTTPS origin of the control deployment proxy; defaults to https://control.<server-domain>.

control_hostname.description: Control API hostname used by ingress and relay processes.

private_control_address.description: Optional private control host and port dialed by ingress and relay processes.

managed_domain_max_member_child_labels.description: Maximum labels beneath a member namespace on the managed domain; 0 uses DNS length limits only.

custom_domains_enabled.description: Allow teams to add custom domains; requires managed DNS automation.

private_control_tls_certificate_file.description: Certificate chain for authenticated internal control HTTPS.

private_control_tls_private_key_file.description: Private key for authenticated internal control HTTPS.

relay_tls_certificate_file.description: Optional static relay transport certificate chain.

relay_tls_private_key_file.description: Optional static relay transport private key.

acme_directory_url.description: ACME directory URL for automatic public certificates.

acme_accept_terms.description: Explicitly accept the ACME directory terms.

public_url_certificate_workers.description: Concurrent public URL certificate workers per control process (1-8).

oidc_issuer.description: OIDC issuer used by the authority.

oidc_client_id.description: OIDC client ID used by the authority.

oidc_client_secret.description: Optional secret for control's OIDC server client.

oidc_admission_file.description: JSON admission rules for the configured direct OIDC issuer.

initial_administrator.description: Exact subject at the configured OIDC issuer; grants administrator once.

initial_team_owner.description: Organization team=subject at the configured OIDC issuer; seeds ownership once.

default_team.description: Initial team selected for explicitly eligible identities.

default_team_member.description: Exact OIDC subject eligible for initial default-team membership; applied once.

web_service_secret.description: Scoped credential for identity-context and website invitation operations.

oidc_scope.description: OIDC scope requested by clients; repeat for each scope.

access_token_lifetime.description: Lifetime of newly issued access tokens.

refresh_token_lifetime.description: Absolute lifetime of newly issued control sessions.

guest_demo_enabled.description: Allow limited anonymous tnl publish --demo runs.

public_url_usage_url.description: Public URL usage receiver base URL.

public_url_usage_token.description: Service token for the public URL usage receiver.

email_url.description: HTTPS origin of the invitation email receiver.

webhook_secret.description: Shared secret for invitation email delivery.

route53_region.description: AWS region used to sign Route 53 requests.

route53_managed_zone_id.description: Existing Route 53 hosted zone ID for the managed domain; enables DNS automation.

route53_server_zone_id.description: Existing Route 53 hosted zone ID for the server domain; enables relay certificate DNS-01.

ingress_ipv4_address.description: Stable ingress IPv4 address published in owned public URL records; repeat for each address.

ingress_ipv6_address.description: Stable ingress IPv6 address published in owned public URL records; repeat for each address.

cluster_secret.description: Current shared secret for private communication among control, ingress, and relays.

cluster_secret_previous.description: Previous cluster secret accepted only during rotation.

storage_key.description: Unpadded base64url AES-256 key used to encrypt recoverable PostgreSQL secrets.

storage_key_previous.description: Previous storage key retained only during re-encryption.

traffic_default_connections.description: Default concurrent visitor connections per public URL publish run on each ingress process.

traffic_default_rate.description: Default new visitor connections per traffic rate period.

traffic_default_upload_bytes.description: Default encrypted visitor upload bytes per second.

traffic_default_download_bytes.description: Default encrypted visitor download bytes per second.

traffic_default_total_connections.description: Default total visitor connections per publish run and ingress process; 0 is unlimited.

traffic_default_total_upload_bytes.description: Default total encrypted upload bytes per publish run and ingress process; 0 is unlimited.

traffic_default_total_download_bytes.description: Default total encrypted download bytes per publish run and ingress process; 0 is unlimited.

traffic_max_connections.description: Maximum selected concurrent visitor connections per publish run.

traffic_max_rate.description: Maximum selected new visitor connections per maximum traffic rate period.

traffic_max_rate_per.description: Rate period used by the operator connection rate ceiling.

traffic_max_upload_bytes.description: Maximum selected encrypted visitor upload bytes per second.

traffic_max_download_bytes.description: Maximum selected encrypted visitor download bytes per second.

traffic_max_total_connections.description: Maximum selected total connections per publish run and ingress process; 0 is unlimited.

traffic_max_total_upload_bytes.description: Maximum selected total encrypted upload bytes per publish run and ingress process; 0 is unlimited.

traffic_max_total_download_bytes.description: Maximum selected total encrypted download bytes per publish run and ingress process; 0 is unlimited.

traffic_source_connections.description: Concurrent visitor connections per IPv4 address or IPv6 /64 on each ingress process.

traffic_source_rate.description: Visitor connection attempts per source per second.

traffic_source_burst.description: Visitor connection attempt burst per source.

traffic_process_rate.description: Visitor connection attempts per ingress process per second.

traffic_process_burst.description: Visitor connection attempt burst per ingress process.

traffic_process_upload_bytes.description: Encrypted visitor upload bytes per second per ingress process.

traffic_process_download_bytes.description: Encrypted visitor download bytes per second per ingress process.

pending_connection_limit.description: Concurrent visitors awaiting authorization per ingress process.

pending_url_connection_limit.description: Concurrent visitors awaiting authorization per public URL.

pending_source_connection_limit.description: Concurrent visitors awaiting authorization per source.

pending_timeout.description: Maximum time a visitor may await authorization.

pending_upload_bytes.description: Encrypted upload byte budget while awaiting authorization.

pending_download_bytes.description: Encrypted download byte budget while awaiting authorization.

pending_url_rate.description: Pending visitor attempts per public URL per second.

pending_url_burst.description: Pending visitor attempt burst per public URL.

pending_source_rate.description: Pending visitor attempts per source per second.

pending_source_burst.description: Pending visitor attempt burst per source.

ingress_pool_id.description: Ingress pool served by this ingress process.

service_port_ranges.description: Managed TCP ports exposed by this ingress pool; direct ingress binds every port, proxied ingress requires destination metadata.

relay_service_id.description: Stable relay service identity for this relay process.

relay_address.description: Relay address advertised by this relay service.

internal_relay_address.description: Internal hostname and port advertised by this relay process.

client_hello_connection_limit.description: Maximum simultaneous public connection metadata and TLS ClientHello inspections (default: automatic).

standalone_control_connection_limit.description: Maximum control connections handed off by standalone, held until close (default: automatic).

standalone_relay_connection_limit.description: Maximum relay TCP connections handed off by standalone, held until close (default: automatic).

publisher_connection_limit.description: Maximum publisher connections held by one relay process (default: automatic).

relay_stream_capacity.description: Maximum concurrent visitor streams held by one relay process (default: automatic).

require_proxy_header.description: Require one trusted outer PROXY v2 header on ingress TCP traffic.

ingress_trusted_proxies.description: Exact trusted peers supplying ingress PROXY v2 source and destination metadata.

quic_max_incoming_streams.description: Maximum incoming QUIC streams per publisher connection (default: relay stream capacity).

lease_renewal_interval.description: Ingress and relay lease renewal interval.

control_retry_interval.description: Delay before retrying a transient control failure.

routing_table_wait.description: Maximum wait for ingress routing-table updates.
